title: 彩色写真を一度グレースケール化してから着替え（衣装変更）させると、元の面影を保ちやすい
content:
彩色写真を一度グレースケール化してから着替え（衣装変更）させると、元の面影を保ちやすい  
彩色写真→（グレースケール化）→着替えの間にフェイスショット生成を挟むと、面影を残しつつ現代風に寄せられる可能性がある

en.content:
Converting a color photograph to grayscale before changing outfits makes it easier to retain the original likeness.  
By inserting face shot generation between the color photo → (grayscale conversion) → outfit change, there's a possibility of maintaining the likeness while giving it a modern touch.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
#BeautifulGirlFrom100YearsAgo
After getting frustrated with the three daughters, I generated this as a breather 😅
Until now, I used to convert color photos to grayscale before changing outfits, but I wondered what would happen if I generated a face shot in between? This is an experiment 🫡
Honestly, I was thrilled 😤
Doesn't it look like someone who could exist today while still retaining the original likeness? https://t.co/nNEt2j8ZOe
---
